propositions: Create-path membership test in outbound_differ uses case-sensitive comparison while applier guard normalizes to uppercase, causing a bridge_project differing only in case to be suppressed on create yet pass the applier guard.

Applier's many-to-many guard store-loading wiring (read_projects via caller apply()) is unit-tested at pure-helper level only, with no end-to-end test exercising the real seeded projects.json load path.
run_differs outbound seam threads projects_store.load_mapping but has no test verifying that a malformed projects.json propagates ValueError and fails closed rather than degrading silently.
Create-path membership must resolve ticket target case-insensitively against mapping keys and stamp the canonical mapping key to align with applier guard normalization.
Integration test required to seed projects.json and drive apply() through store-loading guard, proving foreign keys are refused and member keys are allowed.
run_differs seam test required to verify malformed projects.json aborts outbound phase with ValueError.
